authenticity_review: The image demonstrates exceptional authenticity for an AI-generated sculpture. Wood grain flows logically across complex geometries without breaking or repeating unnaturally. Lighting interactions (specular highlights on varnish, contact shadows on base) are physically plausible. The auxiliary mask shows some fragmentation due to the intricate mane details against a white background, but this is a segmentation limitation, not an image defect. No structural anomalies, fusion artifacts, or biological impossibilities were observed in the source image.
